_ironSightsNote: Iron sights (front and rear) removed when an optic is fitted, so the front post doesn't show through the sight window. On the M16/Commando the bone is the carry handle with the front post; on the FAMAS it's the handle.
_levelsNote: levels: every gun with a Gunsmith has this many levels; its attachments are spread over them (first at level 2, last at levels-2) and the levels between are filler (no unlock: progression and prestige). padTo: guns with fewer attachments than this get stat-only generic ones (generic: true, no model) in the barrel / stock / grip / ammo slots, in catalogue order, until they have padTo. curve: XP to the next level = base * level^exponent.
